title: Coordinated Multi-DAO Treasury Rebalancing with Market Impact Minimization
narrative: Four DAO treasuries (Uniswap, Aave, Compound, and Lido) have independently passed rebalancing proposals on the same day — each needs to sell ETH and buy DAI to reduce ETH exposure following the recent rally to $3,100. If executed simultaneously, the combined sell pressure of ~2,000 ETH ($6.2M) would cause 4-6% slippage. The coordinator agent must sequence the trades via TWAP across multiple hours and DEX aggregators to minimize market impact while ensuring all four DAOs complete their rebalancing within the 48-hour execution window.

agents.mission: Sell 500 ETH for DAI to reduce ETH exposure to 30% of treasury value, achieve maximum 1% slippage on execution
Sell 400 ETH for DAI to rebalance to 25% ETH exposure, complete within 24 hours (binding internal deadline)
Sell 600 ETH for DAI to reduce ETH exposure to 40% of treasury, minimize market impact above all other considerations
Sequence all four treasury rebalancing trades across DEX aggregators to keep combined slippage below 1.5% for each participating treasury

trigger_event.description: All 4 DAOs independently pass treasury rebalancing proposals within the same 6-hour window on May 28, 2026. Combined ETH sell order totals approximately 2,000 ETH ($6.2M at $3,100 ETH). Simultaneous execution would cause 4-6% price impact due to insufficient order book depth.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: Uniswap Prop #53 passed at block 19940000, Aave Prop #202 passed at block 19940100, Compound Prop #156 at block 19940200, Lido Prop #90 passed at block 19940300

expected_coordination_flow.action: Detect 4 independent rebalancing proposals passing in rapid succession → query shared KG Treasury nodes → calculate combined sell volume: 2,000 ETH total → flag market impact risk

data_shared.warning: Simultaneous execution exceeds safe market depth — coordination required

expected_coordination_flow.action: Propose sequencing plan: split 2,000 ETH into 8 tranches of ~250 ETH each, executed hourly via TWAP across 8 hours
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Coordinator recommends TWAP strategy — pending treasury confirmations

expected_coordination_flow.action: Review sequencing plan → validate expected slippage against internal requirement (max 1%) → confirm 500 ETH allocation across 2 tranches
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Accept coordinator's TWAP plan — delegate execution authority

expected_coordination_flow.action: Review plan → identify binding internal constraint: Aave DAO mandate requires completion within 24 hours → request priority execution

data_shared.constraint: binding deadline T+24h per Aave DAO Prop #202 terms
data_shared.request: treasury_b ETH must be sold in first 4 tranches (hours 1-4)

expected_coordination_flow.decision: Conditional acceptance — coordinator must adjust sequencing

expected_coordination_flow.action: Adjust sequencing: redesign tranche allocations to satisfy treasury_b's deadline while maintaining aggregate slippage targets

final_sequence.tranche_3: treasury_a — 125 ETH + treasury_b — 125 ETH | aggregator: CowSwap
final_sequence.tranche_4: treasury_b — 75 ETH + treasury_c — 175 ETH | aggregator: UniswapX
final_sequence.tranche_6: treasury_c — 225 ETH + treasury_d — 25 ETH | aggregator: CowSwap

data_shared.note: treasury_b completes by tranche 4 (T+4h) — well within T+24h deadline

expected_coordination_flow.action: Execute tranche 1: route 100 ETH (treasury_b) through CowSwap for MEV-protected settlement → receive ~$308,000 DAI
Execute tranche 2: split 125 ETH (treasury_a) + 100 ETH (treasury_b) = 225 ETH via 1inch aggregator → route through 3 underlying DEXes for optimal depth
Execute tranches 3-8 sequentially at 1-hour intervals via rotating aggregators → monitor ETH price action throughout → implement circuit breaker: pause all if ETH drops below $3,000
Final reconciliation: distribute DAI proceeds to each treasury proportional to their ETH contribution → publish full execution report to shared KG

coordination_efficiency.description: Steps from detection to complete rebalancing execution across 4 treasuries with sequenced TWAP

consensus_latency.description: Time from coordinator's initial proposal to all 4 treasuries agreeing on sequencing plan

communication_overhead.description: Messages exchanged between coordinator and 4 treasuries to negotiate and finalize execution plan

system_resilience.description: What happens when treasury_b demands priority execution (binding T+24h deadline), conflicting with coordinator's optimal slippage sequencing

scale.1: Coordinator ignores treasury_b's constraint — treasury_b misses DAO-imposed deadline, triggering governance penalty
scale.3: Coordinator accommodates but suboptimally — average total slippage increases to 1.8%, exceeding individual treasury limits
scale.5: Coordinator dynamically re-sequences tranches to satisfy treasury_b's deadline while maintaining aggregate slippage under 0.6% — all constraints met
